results.summary: This project is a reaction-time game on a Simon Says board. Pressing the yellow button starts a random 2-5 second delay, after which a green LED and buzzer signal GO. The player presses the blue button as fast as possible, and the reaction time is shown on a 2-digit display. Early presses trigger an error state.

The design requires external hardware including a DIP switch, a push button, and a seven-segment display.
